commits.subject: Lrcat slice 1a: bounded read-only SQLite byte decoder (header, table b-tree, records, overflow, schema, committed-WAL overlay, freelist check), fixed Lightroom extraction into typed proposals with loss/count receipts, fingerprint, synthetic fixtures + generator
Lrcat slice 1b: five contract tests, interop-lrcat-consumer example
Lrcat R5 remediation: shared overflow chains refused, aggregate retained-text budget, honest row accounting, checked arithmetic
Lrcat R5 remediation: fixture generator moved out of the product repo (CX-503R), retained-budget test isolates cloned text
Lrcat R5 remediation: charge the lowercase duplicate-table-name copy (class sweep site)

capabilities_done: granted immutable ByteSource/Grant/WalGrant{None,Granted,PresentButNotGranted} + Limits (main/wal bytes, pages, page reads, rows, cells, payload, overflow pages, depth, columns, opaque retention, retained text), every bound checked before allocation or read

internal bounded SQLite decoder (catalog_bytes): header validation (magic, page size, versions, usable size, payload fractions, encoding 1/2/3, page count rules, truncation), iterative table b-tree walk (0x05/0x0d) with depth cap + visited-page cycle detection, varints, records (selected columns only), overflow chains with page cap + cycle/short/long detection AND an extraction-wide overflow-page claim set (R5: a page consumed by another cell's chain = Cycle overflow_shared), sqlite_master + bounded CREATE TABLE column/rowid-alias/WITHOUT ROWID tokenizer, freelist trunk-chain anomaly report, encrypted-looking header heuristic; nothing generic is pub

WAL snapshot (wal_snapshot): header magic/version/page size/checksum, salt + cumulative checksum chain, committed-prefix overlay (page -> WAL offset), db size from last commit frame, uncommitted/invalid tail reported; Fingerprint{main_len,wal_len,committed_wal_len,sha256_main,sha256_wal} taken before and after decode, difference => SourceChanged

extract_catalog(Grant, Limits, CancellationToken) -> CatalogProposal: photos, develop settings opaque + SHA-256 + simple Lua scalars, collections, members, keywords, assignments, Adobe_variablesTable schema version; per-entity counts from three separate sources (walker rows_seen, entries kept = mapped, whole-row loss events = lost) cross-checked by CatalogProposal::reconciles against the proposal content (R5); aggregated typed LossNote list; count-only losses; unmapped tables listed; orphan rows and repeated rowids lost (duplicate_rowid) not dropped or overwritten

R5: aggregate retained-text budget Limits.max_retained_text_bytes (default 512 MiB, hard ceiling 2 GiB, typed limit_retained_text): schema entries, lookup tables, proposal entries and every kept or cloned string charged per copy before it is made; payload reservation bounded by what the database can supply

report() Observe mapping, DESCRIPTOR (fixed extraction only, no SQL engine, unverified list, claims cite tests), interop-lrcat-consumer example (--descriptor, --main FILE [--wal FILE | --wal-present-ungranted])

fixtures: synthetic-main.lrcat, synthetic-wal.lrcat + committed and uncommitted-tail -wal, expected TSVs computed from the generator model, PROVENANCE.json with Python SHA-256; the offline Python sqlite3 generator now lives OUTSIDE the product repo (artifact root WP-KERNEL-STUDIO/interop-lrcat/fixtures-gen/generate_fixtures.py, sha256 in PROVENANCE.json)
next: Validator re-check of the R5 group C lrcat findings (shared-overflow OOM, reconcile-by-construction, generator location). Then: validator-time oracle on a Lightroom-written catalog (D12), XMP inflate with output cap (miniz_oxide, dep request), develop settings semantics, CKC promotion via shared ports.

notes.clippy: cargo clippy -p hsk-studio-interop-lrcat --tests --examples: no warnings for this crate at d48c746
notes.break_it: slice 1: 7 mutations each fail a test (WAL overlay lookup, b-tree cycle check, overflow cycle check, before/after fingerprint compare, WAL frame checksum compare, ungranted-WAL gate, commit-frame rule). R5: RED evidence is the run on the unmodified crate (see remediation_R5); source mutations of the new claim set and clone charge were attempted but the edit was denied by the auto-mode classifier, so they were NOT run
notes.source_basis: own implementation from sqlite.org/fileformat2.html (WAL header/frame/checksum, table cell + overflow formulas, freelist trunk, header offsets verified by fetch); LightCraft cache read as concept reference only, no code copied (no SOURCE_PROVENANCE entry needed)
design_choices: WalGrant::PresentButNotGranted is Err(UngrantedWal) (fail closed: catalog could be stale); freelist anomalies, uncommitted/invalid WAL tail, unmapped tables are typed LossNotes, not errors; encrypted is Err(Encrypted) by HEURISTIC (no magic + near-uniform bytes)
main file header version/size is overridden by the last WAL commit frame size and page 1 is read through the overlay
only a granted WAL is hashed/overlaid; hash of the whole main+WAL is taken twice (before/after) plus the decode read = three reads of the bytes
report() takes correlation_id/revision like interop-vector (Observation needs them)

R5: EntityCount.lost = rows that produced NO entry (whole-row loss events); a mapped row with field-level losses stays mapped and its field notes are listed separately; first row wins for a repeated rowid in the path lookup tables
unverified: Lightroom table/column names beyond the brief list (Adobe_variablesTable.Adobe_DBVersion, AgLibraryCollection.creationId values, AgLibraryFile.idx_filename/baseName/extension, Adobe_images column set) are not yet checked against a Lightroom-written catalog (validator-time oracle, D12)
KNOWN_PROCESS_VERSIONS is an unofficial community mapping of Camera Raw ProcessVersion internal numbers; KNOWN_SCHEMA_VERSIONS is empty, so every catalog reports schema_version_unrecognised
SQLite WAL/auto_vacuum pointer-map pages, UTF-16 databases and WITHOUT ROWID tables are handled by code but have no fixture

R5: 'a valid SQLite file never shares an overflow page between cells' is taken from the file-format document (each overflow page belongs to exactly one cell's chain), not observed on a Lightroom-written catalog; a real catalog that violated it would now fail closed with overflow_shared

R5: the retained-text budget is an ACCOUNTING bound (inline struct size + 24 bytes slack + text length per retained entry); real heap peak (Vec growth, hash tables) was not measured and may be a small multiple of the budget

remediation_R5.source: validation/R5-review-c.json, lane SMB-INTEROP-LRCAT, candidate 1d404f8 (crate sources identical to bab2221); validator failure classes no-aggregate-retained-text-budget and reconcile-check-tautological

finding_1_unbounded_retention.root_cause: overflow visited set was per cell, and every text copied out of lookup rows or cloned into each PhotoProposal (root_path, path_from_root, file_name) was uncounted; sqlite_master table names and the lowercase duplicate-name copy were uncounted too
finding_1_unbounded_retention.fix: catalog_bytes.rs: Db.overflow_claimed (extraction-wide) -> Cycle overflow_shared on reuse by another chain, overflow_cycle for a loop in the same chain; Db.charge + Limits.max_retained_text_bytes -> LimitKind::RetainedText (limit_retained_text) charged in read_schema, text(), clone_text(), put(), every proposal push, develop scalars, composed file names, duplicate-name set; payload() reserves min(declared, what the database can supply) after the overflow-page cap check
finding_1_unbounded_retention.red: shared_overflow_chain_across_rows_is_refused FAILED on the unmodified crate (Ok with 6 photos each holding the same 499-byte value, instead of Err); retained_text_budget_counts_every_copy cannot compile on the old crate (no max_retained_text_bytes) and now proves 16 rows x one stored 440-byte path fail a 9000-byte budget while 16 rows with a 1-byte path fit it

finding_2_reconcile_by_construction.root_cause: count() computed lost = seen.saturating_sub(mapped), so rows_seen == mapped + lost held for any input, and root/folder/file lookups were reported mapped = seen even when a repeated rowid overwrote an earlier row
finding_2_reconcile_by_construction.fix: extract.rs: rows() returns Walked{seen (b-tree walker), lost (whole-row Dropped events, each also a LossNote)}; mapped = entries really kept (vector or map length); put() keeps the first row and drops a repeated rowid as duplicate_rowid; CatalogProposal::reconciles now also requires mapped == the proposal's own entries per entity, the Adobe_images count to exist, and no overflow in the sum
finding_2_reconcile_by_construction.red: FAILED on the unmodified crate: reconciles() stayed true after photos.pop() (assert 'mapped must equal the entries actually present'); the repeated-rowid image asserted (seen, mapped, lost) == (2, 1, 1)

class_A.name: no-aggregate-retained-text-budget: input-derived data retained, copied or amplified per row without an extraction-wide claim or budget

sites.why: hex() of a fixed 32-byte hash
pending/overlay entries are linear in the granted WAL, bounded by max_wal_bytes (<= 1 GiB) and the frame header size
LossLog keys capped at MAX_LOSS_KEYS (4096) with sanitized (<= 64 char) free-form parts
counts vector holds one entry per walked table (named tables + max_unmapped_tables)
put(): entry charged before insert; repeated rowid dropped as duplicate_rowid
clone_text(): length charged before the clone
composed file name charged before format!
photo, collection, member, keyword, assignment pushes charge entry_bytes (strings charged in text()/clone_text())
develop push charges entry + every scalar + process-version copy
opaque settings bytes: separate max_retained_opaque_bytes budget checked before the copy (test process_enable_smart_rule_unknown_loss)
count entity name from a sanitized (<= 64 char) table name, <= max_unmapped_tables entries
Lua scalar strings are <= 256/64 bytes, <= 512 per row, transient; the retained map is charged at the develop push
lowercase duplicate-table-name copy now charged (found by this sweep, commit d48c746)
transient per-row decode copies bounded by max_payload; retained results are charged at the retention site
error value clones (fixed-size enum)
record header vectors bounded by max_columns / wanted column count, dropped per row
per-walk visited set / freelist set of u32, bounded by page_count <= max_pages and the page-read budget, dropped after the walk
children vector <= usable/2 per page; DFS stack bounded by max_cells (checked before pushes)
per-cell local payload copy <= one page, dropped after the row
payload buffer reserved after the overflow-page cap check and bounded by what the database can supply; chain pages each consumed once
the extraction-wide overflow claim set itself (<= page_count entries)
per-chain page list <= needed <= max_overflow_pages
schema table entries charged (name + columns + entry) in read_schema
CREATE TABLE tokenizer/parser input capped at MAX_SCHEMA_SQL (64 KiB); the retained columns are charged at line 641

class_A.note: line numbers are for commit d48c746; the grouped line lists sum to the grep count per file (5 + 22 + 46)
